title: ActionFailedPayload
description: A command terminated unsuccessfully — including TIMEOUT from the watchdog, so the 'exactly one outcome per command' invariant holds through crashes. Producer: minecraft-service on world.events.

commandId.description: The eventId of the ActionRequested command this outcome answers.

errorCode.description: Machine-readable failure class; consumers branch on this, never on errorMessage. Survival additions (additive): BODY_BUSY = a reflex (eat) owns the body briefly, retry shortly; SELF_DEFENSE_IN_PROGRESS = the body is fighting or fleeing a hostile, retry after; TARGET_ESCAPED = a hunt's quarry got away (wounded game keeps its damage — a later hunt can finish it). RB-1 additions (additive): TOOL_TIER_REQUIRED = the ore only drops to a higher tool tier than anything carried (the message names the tier — craft it first); SMELT_FAILED = the craft chain's furnace flow broke (no furnace placeable, no fuel, or the smelt yielded nothing — the message teaches the missing link). Unit-10 additions (additive): SUPERSEDED = PLUMBING — the mind changed its mind and dropped its own older intent; the world never refused it, so it must never count toward an abandonment streak (the v7 latest-intent-wins executor has emitted this since 2026-07-27 while the enum stayed silent about it — this entry makes the schema true about the wire again). The remaining seven are the skill library's own vocabulary, closed at services/minecraft-service/src/skills/types.ts: UNSUPPORTED_NAME = the name is not in minecraft-data for this version (an executor-porting bug, not a model affordance — params are enums); RECIPE_UNAVAILABLE = no recipe here (place a crafting_table first, or pick a craftable item); MISSING_MATERIALS = recipe known, ingredients absent (the message lists them); PLACE_FAILED = no legal spot or the world rejected the placement, verified after the fact (move to open ground and retry); CONTAINER_NOT_FOUND = no chest within range (craft+place one); TARGET_NOT_FOUND = the entity or stack the skill needed is absent (herds and villagers move); INVENTORY_FULL = no room for the yield (deposit or toss first); ABORTED = PLUMBING — the harness cancelled the skill mid-flight (shutdown, supersede, reflex preemption), so like SUPERSEDED it says nothing about the intent.
